test_cases.name: case_float_rounding_defect
test_cases.description: Floating-point representation with non-zero residual gap in Q
test_cases.flaw_note: Float 0.3333333333333333 yields sum = 0.9999999999999999 != 1 in Q, failing exact zero gap.

test_cases.name: case_infeasible_dual_gap_match
test_cases.description: Dual candidate achieves objective 1 matching primal, but violates dual bounds and divergence
test_cases.flaw_note: Dual objective w^T*c = 3*(1/3) = 1 matches primal, but ||w||_inf = 3 > 1 and d0^T*w != 0.
